December 9, 1954

Mr. Edgar Kobak
341 Park Avenue
New York, New York

Dear Ed:

Regarding the letter you so kindly sent me from Mr. Ervin, I am enclosing correspondence from the Tobacco Industry Research Committee, which you will see indicates that Mr. Hoyt will be happy to talk with Mr. Ervin if you will arrange it when he comes to New York.

Best regards.

Sincerely,

Albert R. Stevens Advertising Manager

Enclosure
